first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: queue of vehicles in traffic congestion
entities.identification: A collection of background cars densely arrayed along the road, excluding Vehicle A and Vehicle B.

entities.name: clear blue sky
entities.identification: The light blue sky above the vehicles, people, and distant treetops.

entities.name: concrete guardrail
entities.identification: The continuous solid low wall along the outer edge of the left side of the road, distinct from the concrete median barrier on the right.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A turquoise-green car with a boxy front end, black grille, and round headlights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A dark red sedan with a curved roof, hood, and dark windows.

entities.name: surrounding crowd
entities.identification: A collection of other people between the vehicles and near the car roofs, not counting Person A, Person B, Person C, or Person D again.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A woman with short light-blond hair and a red top, mutually embracing and supporting Person B.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A bearded man wearing a loose mustard-yellow top and a red-and-white hat with a dark brim, interacting with Person A.

entities.name: bridge deck roadway
entities.identification: The light gray hard road surface visible between the vehicles and at the lower left of the image.

entities.name: concrete median barrier
entities.identification: The solid light gray-beige dividing wall to the right of Vehicle B, separating the vehicles on the two sides.

entities.name: distant trees
entities.identification: The dark green band of irregular treetops behind the distant group of vehicles on the right.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: A woman with short dark hair, wearing a blue short-sleeved garment, dark blue shorts, and black shoes.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The person who tumbles into the central foreground in the later part, wearing an olive-green top, with brown bottoms partially visible, and having dark hair.
